otherChecks.The Wrath of Lem: With the cached minus-one source phase, Golems saved 79/80 at tick 1379; Original saved 1/80 at tick 1363. One-action perturbation found three 80/80 Golems routes.
otherChecks.Yo-yo Lem-lem: With the cached source phase, Original saved 79/80 at tick 4082; a uniform minus-one further tick saved 80/80 at tick 1858. Golems on the same winning inputs saved 80/80 at tick 1856, matching the source header tick, but this alone is not parity proof.
